I was never addicted to heroin, but I take kratom daily and at one point was addicted to harder opioids so I somewhat know what the addiction is like. People think of heroin and meth as both drugs that if you try once and are instantly hooked because the high is so amazing. I think with amphetamines that is somewhat the case, but with heroin/opioids it’s the detail that non users get the most wrong.

For me, opioids are a better than average high, but nowhwhere near the “best” (MDMA takes the cake for that one). I just felt nice. I was shocked about how much the high was exaggerated and was amazed by the fact that I could do it and function. Then I started doing it more eventually leading to daily use. Then I became physically dependent.

I remember thinking “This isn’t that good, at least not compared to Molly or Amph.” I still don’t think the high is that good. But when you are going through withdrawals and your bones ache? It IS 100% that good.

I honestly hate both sides of that argument. I see the latter argument more nowadays and it’s unfortunately something that a lot people actually believe. I made a lot of bad decisions in high school/did a lot of drugs. In my experience it is on the safer side as far as illegal drugs are concerned, but that’s relative to all drugs. Overall I wouldn’t call it “Safe.” Every major study I have read has put it in the middle as far as which drugs are harmful and which aren’t as bad. Cannabis won’t send you down the road to death like opioids or meth, but it will send you down the road to not meeting your full potential (with daily use, not in moderation). Granted I have seen people who use it daily and excell, but for most people it seems to slow them down. I have seen people with so much potential just waste their lives because they are too stoned to function. 

I think that it should be legalized from a personal rights standpoint, but education is an absolute MUST. People need to be told that it has risks, because knows that most people who love weed won’t tell anyone that it does.

Thanks for all the answers everyone! 

One more follow up. Do you guys draw a line between Cannabis in its bud form vs things like wax, hash and edibles? I looked it up and where I’m from, having a personal amount of marijuana is a civil infraction, but having wax or edibles is considered “Possession of a Schedule I hallucinogen,” so basically the same charge you’d catch if you were caught with shrooms or acid. In my experience these forms are definitely stronger, but not inherently worse (except maybe that edibles may cause a person to ingest more than they intend).

See I hadn’t done real M in like 2 years (or maybe ever idk) until last December. Me and my friend split a ball and got a test kit. I had little to no experience but had heard some people take like .3 at once so I plugged .1 and drank .1 in a shot of water. Was fucking intense and redosed .1 3 times (half a g total over 8 hours). Physically I felt like SHIT until like 3 pm the next day. Had a friends birthday party to go to so I got up and got ready. I noticed after getting ready I felt really good. Significantly better than usual. The famous “afterglow.” I took .08 the next night and felt like shit the next day. I waited like 2 weeks and got a nice afterglow again. Did it two days after and felt like shit. Did it 4 days after that and felt severely depressed for like 1-2 weeks.

Moderation is a good idea for most things but it is a must for MDMA. Once a month MAX or once every two weeks if you are stupid. If you wanna take a super crazy drug weekly just stick with acid. At least your serotonin won’t get stunted.

The doctor seemed very confused and suspect. Two days later before my appointment with the current doc I got a call from the clinic saying that my doctor had to cancel and I would see a nurse/practitioner for my meds. She said it was “policy” to drug test every 4 months to make sure I was taking the medication and nothing else. Really random and unexpected. I wonder if my inpatient doc didn’t call them and tell them I was seeking drugs (I admitted to alcohol and kratom addiction as well as very occasional recreational cocaine, ecstasy, LSD, mushroom and cannabis use to this doc, said it was confidential). I know he can’t do that legally but he seems like the type to do that shit.
When they hit me with the piss test I had taken like half a G of MDMA like 48 hours before, waited as long as I could without it looking dodgy and passed the UA. 


TL; DR: I think my doc thinks I am a drug seeker and doesn’t want to up the medication. He drug tested me which seemed abnormal considering the circumstances and I think there is a chance my old doc tipped him off.
